predictions.rationale: Primary class representing a Use Case diagram; central for creation, behavior, and interaction with the rest of ArgoUML.
Defines the underlying graph model (nodes/edges) specific to Use Case diagrams, directly supporting their semantics.
Handles visual rendering of actors and use-case figures in the diagram; essential for displaying the diagram.
Subsystem initializer that registers the Use Case diagram type, connecting actions, renderers, and factories.
Property panel shown when a Use Case diagram is selected; refines and supports editing diagram-level attributes.
Factory that supplies property panels for Use Case diagrams, tying the diagram type to its UI components.
UI action that allows users to create or open a new Use Case diagram within a project.
Model-layer representation of a Use Case diagram; used for persistence and tool-independent data handling.
Unit tests verifying behavior of UMLUseCaseDiagram; indirectly supports maintenance of the feature.
Tests for the action that creates Use Case diagrams; provides regression coverage for the feature.
